column1: # name             class       release rollback flags provenance-sha256
# Build-time blessing allowlist. Flags are the CLS2 artifact flags from
# charlotte-launch::signature_note. `-` means that no external SBOM or source
# attestation is linked yet; production policy should provide its SHA-256.
# greet is explicitly safe to replicate in parallel, stateless, and forbidden
# from fetching executable code at runtime.
